df888992ccfc74ac380a2a5114596095415769fc.summary: Malpedia family page for Kazuar, a backdoor linked to the Turla actor. It has no description of its own. Its references run from 2017 to 2026 and come from Unit 42, Microsoft, Kaspersky, Accenture, CERT-UA, Google and others. The references name Turla, Secret Blizzard and Pensive Ursa as related actors, and list CAPIBAR, HyperStack and Carbon as companion tools.
